claims.errorType: Provider billed amount exceeds insurance EOB patient responsibility
claims.beniExplanation: Your insurance says you owe $180. That's $300 too much. The hospital cannot balance-bill you beyond the ClearPath negotiated allowed rate.
claims.disputeLetter:
To City Imaging Billing Office:

Re: Invoice #INV-88391-A for Patient Maria Santos (Member ID: CP-BW-88391-01, Service Date: Oct 12, 2027).

I am disputing the billed patient balance of $480.00. According to my ClearPath Explanation of Benefits (EOB #EOB-CP-99412), the contractual allowed amount for procedure 70553 is $900.00, of which ClearPath paid $720.00 (80%), leaving my patient responsibility as exactly $180.00.

As a participating network provider under ClearPath Health and pursuant to the federal No Surprises protections, billing above the contractual patient responsibility is not permitted. Please adjust my account balance from $480.00 to $180.00 and issue a corrected statement.

Sincerely,
Maria Santos
